cohort: The study included 149 monoamniotic twin pregnancies managed at 10 university hospitals in France over an 18-year period.
finding: The study found no significant differences in intrauterine and perinatal mortality rates between inpatient and outpatient management strategies for monoamniotic twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery is not strictly contraindicated for monoamniotic twin pregnancies, but cesarean delivery is considered safe and most often recommended.
gest_age: Pregnancies and fetuses from 26(0/7) to 34(6/7) weeks of gestation were analyzed in one group, and those not born after 35(0/7) weeks in another.
